title: Inkless Agent Fleet Registry
description: Local (or private ops) registry of Inkless instances for multi-site content agents. Each site is one process/instance with its own base_url and API key. Does not introduce multi-tenant site_id in the CMS core (ADR-0001).

default_site.description: Optional default site id when a task does not name a site.

label.description: Human-readable name for agents and UIs.

base_url.description: Instance canonical origin (no trailing slash). Must match that instance BASE_URL / whoami.baseUrl.

api_key_env.description: Environment variable holding the ink_… key for this site. Prefer env refs over plaintext.

api_key_file.description: Optional path to a file containing the plaintext key (single line). Mutually exclusive with embedding secrets in git.

scopes_expected.description: Scopes the agent expects on the key; compare with whoami.scopes after connect.

publish_policy.description: never = refuse publish endpoints; manual = only when user explicitly asks; allow = agent may publish when task requires.

brand.description: Optional tag for filtering (personal, product, client, …).

locale_default.description: Default locale hint for content generation.

notes.description: Free-form operator notes (not sent to the CMS).

whoami.description: Call GET /admin/agent/whoami before writes and match baseUrl.

public_path.description: Optional public path to hit after publish (e.g. / or /public/bootstrap).
